summary: Softer July retail sales and cooling producer and consumer inflation this week reduced urgency for a Fed rate hike in September, dragging the dollar index toward two-month lows. A weaker dollar is amplifying gold's run and lifting risk assets, while coordinated US-Japan currency intervention adds further pressure on the greenback.
tweet: Soft retail sales plus cooler inflation = dollar near two-month lows, gold surging, and stocks in greed territory as September rate-hike bets fade.
